# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The first 30-minute opening range (09:30-10:00 ET) that exhibits a strong volume-biased breakout reflects imbalanced order flow likely to persist intraday. Entering long on the initial volume-confirmed breakout captures this momentum before mean reversion, exploiting the tendency of compressed ranges (OR width < 0.3% SPY) to resolve directionally under low volatility (VIX < 18).

## Mechanism

Calculate OR high/low from 09:30-10:00 ET. After 10:00, on each 1-minute bar: if price closes above OR high AND the bar's cumulative volume delta (buy volume - sell volume) > 0 AND the prior two 1-minute bars also have positive cumulative volume delta, enter long at the bar's close. Initial stop at OR low. Profit target at 1.5× ATR(5) from entry. If price reaches 1× ATR, trail stop to break-even then activate 15% trailing percent of HWM. Only trade when VIX < 18 AND OR width < 0.3% SPY price; avoid 09:30-10:15 ET if VIX > 22 (major news window).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account equals ~14% headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and 3-contract minimum.
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed trigger uses opening range and volume delta primitives with no historical testing in this engine; high overfit risk due to parameter sensitivity (OR width threshold, VIX filter, volume delta lookback) and regime dependence (low volatility compression).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation against real OPRA fills for top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: false breakout during high volatility (VIX > 25) triggering stop at OR low; max drawdown scenario: consecutive losing days in trending markets where OR breaks fail; blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing OR width > 0.3% leading to no trades while market moves sharply.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (cannot estimate if top-5 days would dominate P&L without backtest).
